description.value: Chilli Lee is a family-run Szechuan and Cantonese restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, open since 2010 with the same chef and same address. The menu spans Cantonese classics — soft and crispy chow mein, congee, egg foo yong — alongside real-heat Szechuan dishes, hot pot, and chef's specials. Pickup, delivery, and catering are all available, and the dining room seats 20.
